newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Santander seeks stake in Banco Mercantil - paper.
newsitem.headline: Santander seeks stake in Banco Mercantil - paper.

text.p: Spanish bank Banco Santander is seeking a controlling stake in Venezuela's second largest bank Banco Mercantil, leading daily El Nacional reported Wednesday.

Meetings were first held between senior bank staff last Saturday, the paper reported, over the possible purchase of a 35 percent stake in Mercantil. Neither Banco Santander nor Banco Mercantil were immediately available for comment.
Banco Santander has been widely tipped as the most likely successful bidder for Banco de Venezuela, due to be auctioned December 19.
Reports circulated last week that Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya also wanted to buy a majority stake in Venezuela's largest bank, Banco Provincial.
